metadata.title: Formation and spatial distribution of hypervelocity stars in AGN outflows

notes: No individually identifiable star is named or analyzed as a Galactic unbound candidate. The paper studies a statistical population of hypervelocity stars and refers collectively to observed Milky Way hypervelocity stars; Sgr A* at T:p2-b1 is described only as the Galaxy's supermassive black hole, not as a studied star.
